issues.reason: One symbol makes the KB say the same things are both available-immediately and sealed-for-30-years, which the text never states; Names and casing settles the fix — each "them" is a pronoun with no antecedent in the text, and "an existential witness is anonymous — mint a fresh sk_<class>_<n> each time; witnesses don't corefer".

Categorical statements is explicit that "a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol" and that such a predicate "always goes through the distributive rule", a bare (Member <group> <prop>) being reserved for properties of the collection itself (size, name).
Same violation of the same stated prohibition — (Member sk_group_1 sealed) predicates the members' property of the group-as-object.

Thematic roles lists keep by name under Theme ("acquired, transferred, moved, possessed ... with no change to it"), and the resultative Patient override does not reach it: "keep them sealed" maintains a state rather than bringing one about, so the object does not change.

Coordination & plurals and Cardinality both require it — a grouped plural with a distributive predicate "keeps the group + count + group event ... and adds the per-member rule over (PartOf $x <group>)", exactly as Both dogs barked shows; each state acts separately here.

gaps_confirmed: an unbound PLURAL pronoun with an inanimate referent — Names and casing fixes person for plural they, with no "salient kind" escape of the sort singular "it" gets
contrastive "others" as a second, disjoint subset of an earlier plural — nothing licenses the disjointness or complement relation; RestOf covers only "the rest of X"
no carrier for the quantifier word on an existential plural subject ("some states") — the companion rule expressly exempts existential subjects, so "some" is unrecoverable from the parse
new_gaps: the resultative's mandatory flat (Member <obj> <state>) dual-emit collides with the plural prohibition on (Member <group> <prop>) when the object is a group; nothing states which wins or how the flat half distributes
"keep X ADJ" is a maintenance secondary predicate — neither a resultative (nothing comes to be) nor a plain depictive — and has no licensed route, leaving Result as the nearest fit
covarying pronouns across contrastive clauses ("some states ... them; others ... them", each state's own copies) have no bound-variable route in Coreference & anaphora
repair_summary: Minted a second witness sk_group_2 for the second clause's "them" so the two clauses no longer predicate contradictory states of one set; replaced the flat (Member sk_group_1 available) / (Member sk_group_1 sealed) with distributive rules over (PartOf $x <group>) at (STV 1.0 0.9); changed (Patient sk_keep_1 ...) to (Theme sk_keep_1 sk_group_2); added the per-member Implication rules for both distributive group events, mirroring each group event's class, roles and Result link with Skolem-function events.
notes: The reified result states, the Manner adverb, MeasureAtMost duration for "as much as 30 years", and the absence of tense and connective atoms were left untouched — including the questionable Result link on keep, which no filed issue names.
